def detect(t, fps):
    # n from first entry
    _keys = list(t.keys())
    n = len(t[_keys[0]])
    # helper to fetch array or NaN array (explicit NaN handling, no exceptions)
    def _get(names):
        for k in names:
            if k in t:
                return np.asarray(t[k], dtype=float)
        return np.full(n, np.nan)
    r_present = _get(['r_present', 'present'])
    r_area = _get(['r_area', 'area'])
    i_area = _get(['i_area'])
    r_speed = _get(['r_speed'])
    i_speed = _get(['i_speed'])
    dist_raw = _get(['dist'])
    gap_raw = _get(['gap'])
    r_h_raw = _get(['r_head_to_i', 'r_head_to_body', 'r_head_to_i_body', 'head_to_body'])
    # i head distance not critical but fetched for completeness
    r_face_raw = _get(['r_facing', 'r_face'])
    i_face_raw = _get(['i_facing', 'i_face'])
    r_vis = _get(['r_visible_ratio'])
    i_vis = _get(['i_visible_ratio'])
    # body size L = median sqrt(area) ~125px in 1024x570 view; robust scale
    r_med = np.nanmedian(np.sqrt(r_area))
    i_med = np.nanmedian(np.sqrt(i_area))
    if np.isnan(r_med) and np.isnan(i_med):
        L = 125.0  # fallback pixel scale
    elif np.isnan(r_med):
        L = float(i_med)
    elif np.isnan(i_med):
        L = float(r_med)
    else:
        L = float((r_med + i_med) / 2.0)
    # smoothed versions (0.3s window at 10fps) to resist jitter/head noise
    r_sp_sm = smooth(r_speed, 3)
    i_sp_sm = smooth(i_speed, 3)
    mov = np.fmax(r_speed, i_speed)  # NaN-aware max; high-intensity uses either animal
    mov_sm = smooth(mov, 3)
    dist_sm = smooth(dist_raw, 3)
    gap_sm = smooth(gap_raw, 3)
    rh_sm = smooth(r_h_raw, 3)
    r_face_sm = smooth(r_face_raw, 3)
    i_face_sm = smooth(i_face_raw, 3)
    # proximity: contact = touching/very close; median gap 12.5, p75 202
    contact = gap_sm < (0.25 * L)  # ~31px, touching + slight separation
    tight = gap_sm < (0.08 * L)  # ~10px, essentially overlapping (tracker gap=1 when touching)
    head_close = rh_sm < (0.5 * L)  # ~62px resident head at intruder; median 96, p25 28 => bite
    close_cent = dist_sm < (1.2 * L)  # ~150px centroids overlapping; dist p25 129, median 224
    # motion: L/s ~ body-lengths/s; r p75 155, p95 430; i p75 87, p95 330
    motion_high = mov_sm > (1.2 * L)  # ~150px/s, high-intensity vs sniff/huddle
    motion_vhigh = mov_sm > (2.0 * L)  # ~250px/s, tussle/chase burst near p95
    # core attack: bite/tussle with contact + high motion; headings noisy so no facing req
    core_bite = contact & head_close & motion_high
    core_tussle = tight & motion_vhigh  # head-noisy pile still overlapping + very fast
    core_pile = contact & close_cent & motion_vhigh  # fast pile with close centroids
    core = core_bite | core_tussle | core_pile
    core = core & np.isfinite(mov_sm)  # explicit NaN guard
    # recent core/contact within ~+-1s to restrict chase/occlusion to bout neighborhoods
    k_recent = int(round(float(fps) * 2.0))
    if k_recent < 3:
        k_recent = 3
    recent_core = smooth(core.astype(float), k_recent) > 0.02  # core within ~1s
    recent_contact = smooth(contact.astype(float), k_recent) > 0.02
    # chase/runaway candidate: still close, very fast, resident oriented to intruder
    chase_dist = dist_sm < (2.5 * L)  # ~312px allows brief separation; dist p75 468
    chase_motion = mov_sm > (1.5 * L)  # ~187px/s high-intensity chase
    r_faces = r_face_sm < 1.0  # ~57deg resident facing intruder
    chase = chase_dist & chase_motion & r_faces
    chase_keep = chase & recent_core  # only short chases between attacks, not distant runs
    # occluded tussle: intruder under resident -> i_vis drops (p5 0.5, p25 0.85) or dist/gap NaN
    occluded_flag = (i_vis < 0.65) | (~np.isfinite(dist_raw)) | (~np.isfinite(gap_raw))
    occluded_attack = occluded_flag & motion_high & recent_contact
    # facing pause (rearing facing each other): both slow + both facing + not tightly piled
    r_slow = r_sp_sm < (0.7 * L)  # ~87px/s near medians (57/34), low activity
    i_slow = i_sp_sm < (0.7 * L)
    both_slow = r_slow & i_slow
    both_face = (r_face_sm < 0.9) & (i_face_sm < 0.9)  # ~51deg facing each other
    pause_dist = dist_sm < (2.0 * L)  # pause happens close, not across cage
    pause = both_slow & both_face & (~tight) & pause_dist
    # raw attack then bridge short runaway/chase gaps (up to 1s) but keep pauses negative
    raw = (core | chase_keep | occluded_attack) & (~pause)
    bridged = bouts_clean(raw, fps, min_s=0.3, max_gap_s=1.0)  # 0.3s min bout, 1s bridge inclusions
    final = bridged & (~pause)
    # resident must be detected; do not require intruder (can be occluded/missing in pile)
    if np.all(np.isnan(r_present)):
        r_ok = np.isfinite(r_speed)  # fallback if no present flag
    else:
        r_ok = (r_present == 1)
        r_ok = r_ok & np.isfinite(r_sp_sm + mov_sm + 0.0)  # ensure motion finite? keep occluded? no
        # above would kill occluded where mov finite anyway; recompute simply:
        r_ok = (r_present == 1)
    # if resident missing (NaN speed) force False
    r_ok = r_ok & np.isfinite(r_speed + 0.0)  # NaN speed => not detected
    # allow occluded_attack even if dist NaN: r_ok already covers resident presence
    final = final & r_ok
    return np.asarray(final, dtype=bool)

def detect(t, fps):
    # N from any available array; NaN = missing detection -> False
    N = len(next(iter(t.values())))
    # body size scale: sqrt(area) ~ body width/length (~127 px from medians)
    r_area = np.asarray(t.get('r_area', np.full(N, np.nan)), dtype=float)
    med = np.nanmedian(r_area)
    if np.isfinite(med) and med > 0:
        body = float(np.sqrt(med))
    else:
        body = 125.0  # fallback for 1024x570 view
    # clip degenerate medians from heavy occlusion
    if not np.isfinite(body):
        body = 125.0
    body = float(min(max(body, 80.0), 180.0))

    # fetch arrays (NaN where missing)
    r_present = np.asarray(t.get('r_present', np.full(N, np.nan)), dtype=float)
    i_present = np.asarray(t.get('i_present', np.full(N, np.nan)), dtype=float)
    gap = np.asarray(t.get('gap', np.full(N, np.nan)), dtype=float)
    dist = np.asarray(t.get('dist', np.full(N, np.nan)), dtype=float)
    r_facing = np.asarray(t.get('r_facing', np.full(N, np.nan)), dtype=float)
    r_speed = np.asarray(t.get('r_speed', np.full(N, np.nan)), dtype=float)
    r_hx = np.asarray(t.get('r_head_x', np.full(N, np.nan)), dtype=float)
    r_hy = np.asarray(t.get('r_head_y', np.full(N, np.nan)), dtype=float)
    r_vis = np.asarray(t.get('r_visible_ratio', np.full(N, np.nan)), dtype=float)
    i_vis = np.asarray(t.get('i_visible_ratio', np.full(N, np.nan)), dtype=float)
    # head-to-partner distance key varies: r_head_to_i / r_head_to_body
    _h = t.get('r_head_to_i', None)
    if _h is None:
        _h = t.get('r_head_to_body', None)
    if _h is None:
        _h = np.full(N, np.nan)
    rhti = np.asarray(_h, dtype=float)

    k = max(3, int(round(float(fps) * 0.3)))  # ~0.3 s smoothing, matches speed smoothing
    gap_s = smooth(gap, k)  # suppress 1-frame segmentation jitter on touch boundary
    rhti_s = smooth(rhti, k)  # head point jitter
    dist_s = smooth(dist, k)
    fac_s = smooth(r_facing, k)  # heading noisy; smooth facing cone
    rspd_s = smooth(r_speed, k)

    # head motion = active sniff scanning even when centroid still
    hx_s = smooth(r_hx, k)
    hy_s = smooth(r_hy, k)
    dx = np.full(N, np.nan)
    dy = np.full(N, np.nan)
    dx[1:] = hx_s[1:] - hx_s[:-1]
    dy[1:] = hy_s[1:] - hy_s[:-1]
    head_spd = np.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) * float(fps)
    head_spd_s = smooth(head_spd, k)

    # thresholds relative to body
    gap_thr = 0.30 * body      # ~38px: masks touching/overlapping = close contact
    head_on = 0.40 * body      # ~51px: nose on/near partner (p25 head dist ~28px, med ~96px)
    head_off = 0.60 * body     # hysteresis exit ~76px prevents flicker at sniff boundary
    dist_thr = 2.5 * body      # ~315px: allows nose-to-tail with large centroid sep, excludes far orienting (p75 468px)
    face_thr = 0.9             # ~52deg: directed at partner vs median 1.04 rad undirected
    face_relax = 1.3           # ~74deg allowed only when nose essentially touching (heading unreliable that close)
    nose_touch = 0.20 * body   # ~25px: contact proof, orientation secondary
    low_r = 0.15 * body        # ~19px/s (~p25): above centroid still-noise
    low_h = 0.40 * body        # ~51px/s: above head-point jitter, captures sniff head-bobs
    high_r = 2.5 * body        # ~315px/s (near p90): veto chase/fight bursts, not sniff

    present_ok = (r_present == 1) & (i_present == 1)
    gap_ok = np.isfinite(gap_s) & (gap_s <= gap_thr)
    # hysteresis on closeness (-dist): enter <=head_on, stay until >head_off
    head_hyst = hysteresis(-rhti_s, -head_on, -head_off)
    head_hyst = np.asarray(head_hyst, dtype=bool)
    face_ok = np.isfinite(fac_s) & ((fac_s <= face_thr) | ((np.isfinite(rhti_s) & (rhti_s <= nose_touch)) & (fac_s <= face_relax)))
    dist_ok = np.isfinite(dist_s) & (dist_s <= dist_thr)
    # exclude mounting occlusion where partner hidden under subject (i_visible <<1)
    vis_ok = np.isfinite(r_vis) & np.isfinite(i_vis) & (r_vis >= 0.70) & (i_vis >= 0.60)

    posture = present_ok & gap_ok & head_hyst & face_ok & dist_ok & vis_ok

    # active vs passive: need centroid or head movement; bridge still pauses with 1-s window
    active_inst = (np.isfinite(rspd_s) & (rspd_s >= low_r)) | (np.isfinite(head_spd_s) & (head_spd_s >= low_h))
    # cap absurd head jumps (>5 bodies/s ~62px/frame) as tracking error, not activity
    bad_head = np.isfinite(head_spd_s) & (head_spd_s > 5.0 * body)
    active_inst = active_inst & (~bad_head)
    w = max(3, int(round(float(fps) * 1.0)))  # 1 s window holds sniff pauses
    act_frac = smooth(active_inst.astype(float), w)  # fraction of window with motion
    act_ok = np.isfinite(act_frac) & (act_frac >= 0.15)  # >=~2 moving frames per second
    veto_fast = np.isfinite(rspd_s) & (rspd_s > high_r)

    raw = posture & act_ok & (~veto_fast)
    raw = np.asarray(raw, dtype=bool)
    # drop <0.3s flickers (heading glitches), fill <=0.5s gaps (look-away/head-bob)
    out = bouts_clean(raw, fps, min_s=0.3, max_gap_s=0.5)
    return np.asarray(out, dtype=bool)

def detect(t, fps):
    # --- get n (no try/except) ---
    n = -1
    for v in list(t.values()):
        av0 = np.asarray(v)
        if av0.ndim >= 1:
            n = av0.shape[0]
            break
    if n is None or n == -1:
        return np.zeros(0, dtype=bool)
    n = int(n)
    if n <= 0:
        return np.zeros(0, dtype=bool)

    def _get(*cands):
        for nm in cands:
            if nm in t:
                av = np.asarray(t[nm], dtype=float)
                if av.ndim == 0:
                    continue
                if av.ndim != 1:
                    av = np.asarray(av.ravel(), dtype=float)
                if av.shape[0] != n:
                    continue
                return av
        return np.full(n, np.nan)

    r_area = _get('r_area')
    i_area = _get('i_area')
    r_cx = _get('r_cx', 'r_x')
    i_cx = _get('i_cx', 'i_x')
    dist = _get('dist')
    gap = _get('gap')
    r_vis = _get('r_visible_ratio', 'r_visible', 'r_vis')
    i_vis = _get('i_visible_ratio', 'i_visible', 'i_vis')
    r_face = _get('r_facing', 'r_face')
    i_face = _get('i_facing', 'i_face')
    r_h = _get('r_heading')
    i_h = _get('i_heading')
    r_speed = _get('r_speed')
    i_speed = _get('i_speed')
    r_ht = _get('r_head_to_i', 'r_head_to_body', 'r_head_to', 'r_head_to_intruder', 'r_htob')
    r_present = _get('r_present', 'r_exist')
    i_present = _get('i_present', 'i_exist')

    # --- body size L = median sqrt(area), ~125px ---
    r_sqrt = np.sqrt(np.where(np.isfinite(r_area) & (r_area > 0), r_area, np.nan))
    i_sqrt = np.sqrt(np.where(np.isfinite(i_area) & (i_area > 0), i_area, np.nan))
    Lr = np.nanmedian(r_sqrt)
    Li = np.nanmedian(i_sqrt)
    if np.isfinite(Lr) and np.isfinite(Li):
        L = (float(Lr) + float(Li)) * 0.5
    elif np.isfinite(Lr):
        L = float(Lr)
    elif np.isfinite(Li):
        L = float(Li)
    else:
        L = 125.0
    if not np.isfinite(L) or L < 20.0 or L > 400.0:
        L = 125.0

    # --- smoothing window 0.5 s (5 at 10 fps) to bridge jitter ---
    ffps = float(fps) if np.isfinite(float(fps)) else 10.0
    if ffps < 1.0:
        ffps = 10.0
    k = int(round(ffps * 0.5))
    if k < 3:
        k = 3
    if k > n and n >= 3:
        k = n
    if k < 1:
        k = 1

    # --- thresholds relative to L ---
    dist_thr = 0.9 * L  # centroids within <1 body radius => stacked; p25 dist 129
    gap_thr = 0.2 * L  # ~25px touching/overlap; median gap 12.5, p75 202 far
    head_thr = 0.6 * L  # ~75px head on other body for grasp; median head_to 96, p25 28
    r_face_thr = 1.0  # 57 deg cone: resident facing intruder for rear mount
    i_face_thr = 2.0  # 115 deg: intruder facing away (rear attack vs nose-nose)
    align_thr = 0.3  # cos>0.3 => headings within ~72 deg, same direction rear mount
    vis_thr = 0.8  # 20% area loss = under; i_vis p25 0.846 so lower tail = occlusion
    i_still_thr = 1.0 * L  # ~125 px/s still grapple; i_speed p75 87, p95 330 chase
    r_still_thr = 2.0 * L  # ~250 px/s allow resident movement; r_speed p75 155, p95 430

    # --- missing / occlusion handling ---
    i_nan = (~np.isfinite(i_cx)) | (~np.isfinite(i_area))
    i_nan = i_nan | (np.isfinite(i_present) & (i_present < 0.5))
    r_ok = np.isfinite(r_cx) & np.isfinite(i_cx if False else r_cx) & np.isfinite(r_area)
    # resident must be detected; allow r_present NaN as present, require >0.5 if finite
    r_ok = r_ok & ((~np.isfinite(r_present)) | (r_present > 0.5))

    # forward-fill dist/gap so hidden period inherits last proximity;
    # far disappearance stays far, close mount stays close
    idx = np.arange(n)
    fin_d = np.isfinite(dist)
    ff_d = np.maximum.accumulate(np.where(fin_d, idx, -1))
    dist_ff = np.full(n, np.nan)
    has_d = ff_d >= 0
    dist_ff[has_d] = dist[ff_d[has_d]]
    fin_g = np.isfinite(gap)
    ff_g = np.maximum.accumulate(np.where(fin_g, idx, -1))
    gap_ff = np.full(n, np.nan)
    has_g = ff_g >= 0
    gap_ff[has_g] = gap[ff_g[has_g]]

    # close history at each sample (NaN->False)
    dist_was_close = np.isfinite(dist_ff) & (dist_ff < dist_thr)
    gap_was_close = np.isfinite(gap_ff) & (gap_ff < gap_thr)
    # missing intruder only counts as occlusion if last seen close (under), not far loss
    i_nan_close = i_nan & (dist_was_close | gap_was_close)

    # filled series for smoothing: finite stays, close-missing -> close value, else NaN
    dist_fill = np.where(np.isfinite(dist_ff), dist_ff, 1e6)  # no history -> far
    gap_fill = np.where(np.isfinite(gap_ff), gap_ff, 1e6)
    dist_s = smooth(dist_fill, k)
    gap_s = smooth(gap_fill, k)

    i_vis_f = np.where(np.isfinite(i_vis), i_vis, np.where(i_nan_close, 0.0, np.nan))
    i_vis_s = smooth(i_vis_f, k)
    r_ht_f = np.where(np.isfinite(r_ht), r_ht, np.where(i_nan_close, 0.0, np.nan))
    r_ht_s = smooth(r_ht_f, k)
    r_face_f = np.where(np.isfinite(r_face), r_face, np.where(i_nan_close, 0.0, np.nan))
    i_face_f = np.where(np.isfinite(i_face), i_face, np.where(i_nan_close, np.pi, np.nan))
    r_face_s = smooth(r_face_f, k)
    i_face_s = smooth(i_face_f, k)
    cos_raw = np.cos(r_h - i_h)  # NaN if either heading NaN/noisy
    cos_f = np.where(np.isfinite(cos_raw), cos_raw, np.where(i_nan_close, 1.0, np.nan))
    cos_s = smooth(cos_f, k)
    i_speed_f = np.where(np.isfinite(i_speed), i_speed, np.where(i_nan_close, 0.0, np.nan))
    i_speed_s = smooth(i_speed_f, k)
    r_speed_s = smooth(r_speed, k)

    # --- conditions (NaN comparisons -> False, explicit safe) ---
    prox = (dist_s < dist_thr) | (gap_s < gap_thr) | i_nan_close
    grasp = np.isfinite(r_ht_s) & (r_ht_s < head_thr)  # climbing w/o grasp rejected here
    still = np.isfinite(i_speed_s) & np.isfinite(r_speed_s) & (i_speed_s < i_still_thr) & (r_speed_s < r_still_thr)
    rearR = np.isfinite(r_face_s) & (r_face_s < r_face_thr)
    rearI_align = (np.isfinite(i_face_s) & (i_face_s > i_face_thr)) | (np.isfinite(cos_s) & (cos_s > align_thr))
    occ = np.isfinite(i_vis_s) & (i_vis_s < vis_thr)
    # missing-close already pulls i_vis_s down, but keep explicit for long hides
    occ = occ | i_nan_close

    # need 2 of {resident-facing, intruder-away/aligned, occluded}:
    # rejects nose-nose investigation (only rearR) and far/brief contacts
    sup = (rearR.astype(np.int64) if hasattr(rearR, 'astype') else rearR) + (rearI_align.astype(np.int64) if hasattr(rearI_align, 'astype') else rearI_align) + (occ.astype(np.int64) if hasattr(occ, 'astype') else occ)
    must = prox & grasp & still & r_ok
    raw = must & (sup >= 2)
    raw = np.asarray(raw, dtype=bool)

    # --- temporal cleanup: mounts last seconds, bridge jitter ---
    # min 0.5s rejects brief climbs/touches, max gap 0.3s bridges occlusion flicker
    cleaned = bouts_clean(raw, ffps, min_s=0.5, max_gap_s=0.3)
    out = np.asarray(cleaned, dtype=bool).ravel()
    if out.size != n:
        out = np.asarray(raw, dtype=bool).ravel()
        if out.size != n:
            tmp = np.zeros(n, dtype=bool)
            m = out.size if out.size < n else n
            if m > 0:
                tmp[0:m] = out[0:m]
            out = tmp
    # ensure 1-D bool length n
    out = np.asarray(out, dtype=bool).reshape(n)
    return out
